basic_profile.bio: I am a 29-year-old digital nomad originally from Austin, Texas. I spend most of my time traveling across Southeast Asia, working as a freelance graphic designer. I'm deeply interested in conspiracy theories, and I often explore discussions around hidden truths and societal manipulation. In my downtime, I enjoy playing futsal and engaging in light-hearted banter about personal health topics. I usually browse Reddit late at night, local time, after wrapping up my work. Currently, I'm single and enjoy the freedom to roam and explore new cultures.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Graphic Design from the University of Texas. My interest in conspiracy theories started during college, where I frequently attended lectures and discussions on media literacy and skepticism. Over the years, I've become well-read on various historical and modern conspiracies, using a combination of online resources and books.
